title: GeoQuads — Daily
spoiler: Some of these names live a double life.
help: Find the 4 hidden categories. Each has 4 unique items.

groups.name: Landlocked countries in Europe
groups.fact: Liechtenstein and Uzbekistan are the only two doubly landlocked countries: every neighbour is landlocked too.

groups.name: Rivers of Africa
groups.fact: The Nile, at about 6,650 km, is traditionally considered the world's longest river, though the Amazon is a rival for the title.

groups.name: Capitals of Asia
groups.fact: Kathmandu sits in a valley about 1,400 metres above sea level.

groups.name: Island nations of the Indian Ocean
groups.fact: The Maldives is the lowest-lying country on Earth, with an average ground level of about 1.5 metres above the sea.
